rationale: empty event exactly fitting incoming qty 2: reserve should succeed while release of jack is no-op; interleaving exposes phantom delete of just-inserted row and lost update on reserved causing sum mismatch
full event held by other holder with no jack seats: reserve qty 2 must reject and release is no-op; any success shows overbooking or dirty read and tests rejection seats_available staleness

jack holds all seats with room for exactly 2 more: direct conflict where reserve read-modify-writes jack rows and counter while release deletes same rows; exposes lost update, double counting and duplicate-holder handling

full event where jack holds half and other holder holds half: reserve needs 2 but is full until release frees exactly 2; success depends on ordering so stale capacity check causes overbooking or bogus rejection
